title: Cardinal Periodic Buff Startup Recursion Fix

rootCause.failure: Stored overdue periodic heal called calculateDerivedPlayerStats while active-buff totals were already being collected, recursively re-entering normalizeActiveBuffs until Maximum call stack size exceeded.

fixes: Active-buff bonus aggregation uses normalization with processPeriodic=false.
Player-save loading cleans active buffs without running periodic heal/SP drain/pulse effects.
Normal runtime ticks still execute periodic healing after startup.
Global black-gold number controls skip the auto-combat panel and its dedicated compact controls.
Black-gold MutationObserver audits are batched once per animation frame.
